svg.text: Offline translation models: open test sets, speed and footprint
MB on the GPU, lower is better
ms, median, 4 threads, lower is better
MB working set on the CPU, lower is better
Zhiyi v5-1024 = v4's structure with ambiguous-word data for about 17,000 words (469,000 pairs, three sampled
Hy-MT2-30B-A3B translations each) and a 28-layer teacher's output probabilities, plus a part-of-speech head;
released in release translator, the IME runs v4.
Zhiyi v4 = v3's structure trained on about 3.6 million pairs: 0.88 million new ones aimed at v3's weak spots, Hy-MT2-30B-A3B
for items whose meaning the context decides and for about 1,100 ambiguous words, and a 28-layer teacher's output
probabilities (the teacher is not released); the IME runs it since 1.5.16.
Zhiyi v3 = NiuTrans LMT-60-0.6B with 8 of its 28 layers removed, distilled from Hy-MT2-7B's translations of about
2.75 million candidates and sentences in 9 languages (zh en ja ko fr de es ru vi); LMT-60 is the original base of all;
7B is v3's teacher (not released). COMET-22: Unbabel/wmt22-comet-da x100, averaged over directions, (a)-(c) start at 50;
FLORES-200 devtest and NTREX-128 cover every pair of the 9 languages.
Off-target: by script (e.g. Chinese where Korean was asked for).
Speed and footprint: llama.cpp b11480 (Vulkan), 10 parallel slots and no prompt cache as in the IME, 1,730 real
candidates the language packs lack, 7 a page in parallel, Ryzen 5 9600X / RTX 5070 Ti; the 7B CPU time is over 346.
